Airline Notice on Hazardous Materials 
Please note that U.S. Federal law forbids the carriage of hazardous materials aboard aircraft in your luggage or on your person. A violation can result in five years' 
imprisonment and penalties of $250.000 or more (49 U.S.C. 5124). Hazardous materials include explosives. compressed gases. flammable liquids and solids. oxidizers. 
poisons. corrosives and radioactive materials. Examples: Paints. lighter fluid. fireworks. tear gases. oxygen bottles, and radio-pharmaceuticals There are special exceptions 
for small quantities (up to 70 ounces total) of medicinal and toilet articles earned in your luggage and certain smoking materials carried on your person For further

Yeah, this is a tough situation. 
Channels on AppleTV are apps. Anyone can install apps on the 
AppleTV by logging in with their Apple IDs 
(and remember to sign out after), but how 
each channel handles content licensing is up 
to them -- some have subscription services 
that you can buy, others require you sign in 
with a partnered cable account, etc. 
For example: 
• for HBO Go (or CNN Go) you have to sign in with a cable account 
that has the HBO channel on the account. 
EFTA_R1_00953746 
EFTA02219479
--- PAGE 6 ---
• for HBO Now, you have to subscribe for $X per month, billed to your 
Apple ID. 
• for Disney's channels, you have to sign in with an authorized cable 
account, BUT TimeWamer is not one of the 
options. 
So it's a bit of a mess. 
For Nilli & Ehud I signed into one of the news channels as the account 
connected to 9 E 71st, but each cable 
account can only be on 5 devices at once 
(and Jeffrey has A LOT of devices he uses 
personally). 
I'm not sure what the solution is here. I'll think on it, but I may need

without obtaining a refund and such other provider fails to provide the agreed-upon transportation or service. In this situation. the initial seller of travel must provide the 
passenger with a written statement accompanied by bank records establishing the disbursement of the customer payment, and if disbursed to a registered wholesaler of 
travel, proof of current registration of that wholesaler. This transaction is covered by the California Travel Consumer Restitution Fund (TCRF) if the seller of travel was 
registered and participating in the TCRF at the time of sale and the passenger is located in California at the time of payment. Eligible passengers may file a claim with the 
TCRF if the passenger rs owed a refund of more than $50 for transportation or travel services which the seller of travel failed to forward to a proper provider or such money 
was not refunded to the passenger when required The maximum amount that may be paid by the TCRF to any one passenger is the total amount paid on behalf of the 
passenger to the seller of travel. not to exceed 515.000 Adair,' must be submitted to the TCRF within 12 months after the scheduled completion date of the travel. A claim 
must include sufficient documentation to prove the claim and a 535 processing fee. Claimants must agree to waive their right to other civil remedies against a registered 
participating seller of travel for matters arising out of a sale for which a TCRF claim is filed. A claim form may be requested by writing to: Travel Consumer Restitution 
Corporation: P.O. Box 6001: Larkspur. CA 94977-6031: or by visiting the TCRF's website at

contract between the seller of travel and the purchaser will be refunded within thirty (30) days of receiving the funds from the vendor with whom the services were arranged, 
or if the funds were not sent to the vendor, the funds shall be returned witin fourteen (14) days after cancellation by the seller of travel to the purchaser unless the 
purchaser requests the seller of travel to apply the money to another travel product and/or date.

must include sufficient documentation to prove the claim and a 535 processing fee. Claimants must agree to waive their right to other civil remedies aga list a registered 
participating seller of travel for matters arising out of a sale for which a TCRF Claim is filed. A claim form may be requested by writing to: Travel Consumer Restitution
